archive_metadata.session_export_note: Parent session ID not identifiable from subagent context; durable artifacts captured below

technical_summary.root_cause: Wire protocol had no tool-calling support — tools/tool_choice/parallel_tool_calls dropped on request unmarshal/marshal; tool_calls/tool_call_id/name dropped on response unmarshal/marshal. Same class of bug as reasoning_content (issue #204).
technical_summary.solution: Added wire types to pkg/protocol/api.go (Tool, FunctionSpec, FunctionCall, ToolCall); extended ChatRequest (Tools, ToolChoice, ParallelToolCalls) and ChatMessage (ToolCalls, ToolCallID, Name); all omitempty for wire-compatibility with plain chat. Worker forwards tools via applyToolRequest() in both streaming (openai_stream.go) and non-streaming (openai.go) paths. Router passes body through unchanged.

key_files.pkg/protocol/api.go: Single wire-protocol location (ADR 0004) — 10 wire types added
key_files.pkg/protocol/api_test.go: Round-trip tests for request/response/streaming deltas + wire-compat guards
key_files.pkg/worker/openai_stream.go: Streaming applyToolRequest() call in buildChatRequest + shared helper
key_files.pkg/worker/openai_test.go: Streaming regression test (mock SSE with tool_calls delta sequence) + non-streaming test

technical_summary.out_of_scope: Router-side scheduling awareness, function/agent execution, app/ desktop module, completions endpoint
